recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-7897 unless a later work group decision changes the patient-vs-subject search parameter policy.
issue_request: Published PHER change request resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. The decisive recommendation was to remove subject search parameters where a patient parameter is defined, while retaining both subject and patient only for resources whose subject can be a patient among other target types.
initial_application: Git commit b4d544060a explicitly mentions #7897 and removes the Immunization subject search parameter row from source/immunization/immunization-spreadsheet.xml while retaining the patient search parameter. Later source refactoring moved search parameters to bundle-*-search-params.xml files without reintroducing the stale subject parameter.
additional_context: FHIR-3705 had already renamed Immunization.subject to Immunization.patient under the same patient-vs-subject naming rule. source/fhir.ini actively includes both immunization and allergyintolerance, and current source search parameter bundles define patient search parameters for both. Community searches found no contrary Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active FHIR core source already matches the FHIR-7897 decision and no source correction is needed.
